bibliographic-data.invention-title: BENUTZERSCHNITTSTELLE FÜR LOYALITÄTSKONTEN UND PRIVATKUNDENKONTEN FÜR EINE WEARABLE-VORRICHTUNG
INTERFACE UTILISATEUR POUR COMPTES DE FIDÉLITÉ ET COMPTES DE MARQUE PRIVÉE POUR UN DISPOSITIF PORTABLE
USER INTERFACE FOR LOYALTY ACCOUNTS AND PRIVATE LABEL ACCOUNTS FOR A WEARABLE DEVICE

abstract.p: The present disclosure generally relates to the use of loyalty accounts, private label payment accounts, and general payment accounts using a wearable electronic device with an electronic wallet. Various accounts are linked to the electronic device. In some examples, the electronic device is NFC-enabled. The electronic device may be used to provide loyalty account information and payment account information to a payment terminal, such as an NFC-enabled payment terminal.
